result_text:
I replaced the emoji regex with a single character class in v4 and v3, so rejecting `"🦰".repeat(26) + " "` no longer blows up. I haven't run the v3 path or the full test suite, only the v4 tests below.

- **Regex:** the pattern is now `^[\p{Extended_Pictographic}\p{Emoji_Component}]+$`. It is in `packages/zod/src/v4/core/regexes.ts` (still with the `u` flag) and `packages/zod/src/v3/types.ts`. The set of accepted strings is unchanged.
- **Tests:**
  - **Snapshots:** I updated the expected pattern in `continuability.test.ts` and `to-json-schema.test.ts`.
  - **New emoji test:** in `string.test.ts` it checks that `"🦰🦱🦲🦳"` parses and that the 26×🦰 plus space input is rejected in under 100 ms.
  - **Run:** that test file and the two snapshot files pass.
- **Recheck sweep:** I ran `recheck` on every exported `RegExp` and on the factory outputs you listed (`emoji`, `mac`, `uuid`, `string`, `time`, `datetime`), using each pattern's real source and flags. It flagged none. I used a throwaway test file for this and deleted it, so no permanent recheck test went into the repo. Say so if you want one added.
